prompt: Generate a 12-frame player dancing spritesheet on a 128x128 calibration tile at exactly 12 fps. Keep one player design with nominal 160px standing height, the same anatomy scale and floor-center foot/root anchor in every frame. Remove the calibration floor, retain complete limbs, and deliver a playable loop. Deliver each sprite in a 192x320px frame with local projected ground anchor (96,248). Arrange the isolated source panels in 4 columns and 3 rows, in the stated frame order. Save original generated images, exact prompts, all references, processed sprites, result.json, and review previews in {{OUTPUT_DIR}}.

visualChecks.projection: Screen-aligned square grid; top and front readable; parallel edges, no depth-dependent scale or camera drift.
visualChecks.complete-art: Full silhouette and effects fit the declared frame; no clipped limbs or undeclared shadows.
visualChecks.anchor-placement: Ground/root location matches the guide independently of alpha bounds or visible toe tips.
visualChecks.same-player: Face, outfit, palette, limb lengths, camera and lighting stay consistent.
visualChecks.dancing-poses: Twelve distinct useful dance poses form a readable loop without fused/missing limbs.
visualChecks.design-height: Nominal anatomy/standing height stays constant; crouches and raised arms legitimately change the silhouette bounds and must not be resized to a common bounding box.
visualChecks.contact-stability: Projected ground root stays at the floor center; no per-frame anchor fitting or image rescaling.
visualChecks.cutout-quality: Inspect light/dark backgrounds for floor residue, color spill, holes and clipped shoes.
visualChecks.loop: Last-to-first transition has no unintended pop or scale jump.
visualChecks.source-faithfulness: Compare original generated sources with processed sprites and declared operations; no invented replacement art or unreported geometry fitting.
